class.name: AudioDuckMix
class.brief_description: Source-keyed, bounded, overlapping audio ducking envelope for game mix buses.
class.description: A data-only audio ducking mixer inspired by Unreal Engine Audio Modulation control-bus mixes. Up to 32 named events can hold independent volume reductions (from -60 dB to less than 0 dB); the deepest live event wins. Re-triggering a source refreshes its duration and retains the deeper attenuation without creating a duplicate. [method tick] expires sources and ramps current gain toward the deepest active target, defaulting to a 40 dB/s attack and 4 dB/s release. The caller may apply [method get_current_db] as an offset to the existing AudioServer bus gain, preserving user volume sliders. Does not perform audio DSP, communicate with the audio render thread, or modify buses itself.

method.name: trigger
method.description: Creates or re-triggers one independent ducking event. Source length must be 1 to 128 characters; depth must be finite in [-60, 0), and hold must be finite in (0, 30] seconds. Returns false for invalid inputs or when the 32-source limit is reached.

method.name: release_source
method.description: Stops this event immediately, then allows the next [method tick] to release its attenuation.

method.name: tick
method.description: Advances timers and returns the current dB attenuation. Nonfinite, zero and negative delta values do not advance state.

method.name: set_rates
method.description: Configures independent positive finite attack and release speeds (at most 120 dB/s), atomically.

method.name: get_current_db
method.description: Returns the smoothed volume attenuation, at most 0 dB.

method.name: get_target_db
method.description: Returns the deepest currently active source attenuation, or 0 dB.

method.name: get_remaining
method.description: Returns this source's remaining hold duration, or zero.

method.name: get_source_count
method.description: Returns the number of currently active named sources.

method.name: has_source
method.description: Returns whether this source currently contributes to the ducking mix.

method.name: clear
method.description: Immediately resets the mix to 0 dB and removes all sources.
